<html:div id="wizardExternalKeyProvideKeyId">
          <html:fieldset>
            <html:legend data-l10n-id="openpgp-external-key-description">
            </html:legend>

            <description data-l10n-id="openpgp-external-key-info" />

            <separator />

            <hbox align="center">
              <label
                for="externalKey"
                data-l10n-id="openpgp-external-key-label"
              ></label>
              <hbox class="input-container" flex="1">
                <html:input
                  id="externalKey"
                  type="text"
                  class="input-inline"
                  placeholder="0x0123456789ABCDEF"
                  required="required"
                  minlength="16"
                  maxlength="80"
                  pattern="(0x)?(?:(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4} ?){4}|(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4} ?){10}|(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4} ?){16})(?<![ ])$"
                />
              </hbox>
            </hbox>

            <separator />

            <hbox
              id="openPgpExternalWarning"
              class="inline-notification-container info-container"
              collapsed="collapsed"
            >
              <hbox class="inline-notification-wrapper">
                <html:img
                  class="notification-image"
                  src="chrome://messenger/skin/icons/information.svg"
                  alt=""
                />
                <description data-l10n-id="openpgp-external-key-warning" />
              </hbox>
            </hbox>
          </html:fieldset>
        </html:div>

        <html:div id="openpgpImportOwnKey" hidden="hidden">
          <vbox id="openPgpImportPublicKeyWarning" hidden="hidden" />

          <html:fieldset>
            <html:legend
              data-l10n-id="openpgp-import-own-key-title"
            ></html:legend>
            <html:p id="openpgpImportOwnPublicKey"></html:p>

            <separator />

            <button
              id="importPublicKeyButton"
              data-l10n-id="openpgp-import-key-button"
              oncommand="importPublicKey()"
            />

            <separator class="thin" />
          </html:fieldset>
        </html:div>
